name: Heartbreaker: Pulse & Punish
subtitle: AR / LMG burst DPS — second-highest single-target damage in the game

statsLeft.v:
Kingbreaker AR (named TKB-408 · Perfect Flatline: +20% damage to pulsed targets) primary
Shotgun or LMG secondary — builds stacks fast at fight start

Technician Linked Laser Pointer — pulses enemies on aim (passive)
Reviver Hive or Reinforcer Chem Launcher

statsRight.v: 6× Red — HB drops with blue cores, recalibrate to red at endgame
Fox's Prayer / Contractor's Gloves are NOT BIS on this build — use brand pieces for crit instead

warn: HB chest (Max BPM) raises the stack cap from 50 to 100 — do not swap it for another talent. The HB backpack is also not recommended; use Ceska with Vigilance instead for immediate damage with no ramp-up wait.
playstyle: Heartstopper (4pc) pulses enemies on headshots. Each hit on a pulsed enemy stacks +1.1% weapon damage and +1% bonus armour, up to 100 stacks — that's +110% weapon damage as a separate multiplier at full stacks. Two stacks bleed off per second so maintain constant fire. The Technician's Linked Laser Pointer makes stacking consistent by pulsing the instant you aim, removing the need for headshots to prime the mechanic. Kingbreaker's Perfect Flatline layers an additional +20% onto pulsed targets. Strong survivability for a DPS build thanks to the stacked bonus armour.

name: Hunter's Fury: Speed Farmer
subtitle: CQC SMG — Control Points, open world, Summit lower floors

statsLeft.v:
SMG primary — Chatterbox or Dark Winter
Shotgun secondary for tight gaps

statsLeft.opt: materially stronger with it — build works without

statsRight.v:
Crit Chance ~50%
Crit Damage · Weapon Damage

playstyle: Hunter's Fury rewards aggression — Intimidate's damage bonus scales with proximity, so this build wants to be constantly in the enemy's face. Memento stacks weapon damage and armour regen as you chain kills, so momentum compounds on itself: the more you press forward, the harder and safer you become. Best for open-world patrol, Control Points, and Summit lower floors where closing distance is safe. Not suited to long-range Legendary content.

statsLeft.v:
Model 700 or 1886 Rifle · Determined talent

AR secondary for close-range fallback

statsRight.v: 6× Red — Headshot Damage as attribute on every piece

Headshot Damage maximised
across all slots

playstyle: Perfect Headhunter (chest): after a headshot kill, your next hit deals +150% of the killing blow's damage (cap: 800% weapon damage, or 1250% if Headshot Damage exceeds 150%). Determined (weapon): after a headshot kill, the next shot is a guaranteed headshot — starting a chain. Hotshot's 4pc Headache ability cycles through bonuses on consecutive headshots: first boosts the next headshot 20%, second grants armour, third refills the mag, then repeats. When the chain flows, entire encounters dissolve in seconds. One body shot resets everything. Earn your mechanics on Striker first.

name: Negotiator's Dilemma: DoT Spreader
subtitle: LMG · multi-target damage spread — relaxed and group-friendly

statsLeft.v:
Pestilence exotic LMG primary
— viral DoT spreads between marked targets
AR secondary for single-target cleanup

statsLeft.opt: core to the viral spread — Negotiator's still works without it but loses the DoT chain

playstyle: Negotiator's marks enemies — critical hits on one marked target deal a percentage of that damage to all other marked targets simultaneously. Pestilence adds a viral plague DoT that spreads between marked enemies. Tag a group, let the cross-damage and DoT chain multiply across them. Cover-friendly and momentum-free: no kill chain needed to maintain output. Naturally team-friendly since the DoT applies regardless of who finishes the kills. A relaxed, satisfying build in any dense encounter.

name: Backfire: Glass Cannon
subtitle: Exotic SMG · high-risk run-and-gun — sort your bleed first

statsLeft.v:
Backfire exotic SMG — mandatory, this is the build
Shotgun secondary for reload gaps

statsRight.v:
Crit Damage (Backfire inherently high)
Crit Chance
Bleed Resistance via Hazard Protection mods

warn: Backfire bleeds you on every reload. This build only functions once Bleed Resistance is stacked high enough via Hazard Protection mods to negate the self-inflicted bleed. Without solving the bleed first, you will die to your own weapon. Build Striker first.
playstyle: When the bleed mitigation is sorted, Backfire delivers an extremely kinetic, high-damage experience — massive inherent crit damage shreds targets at pace. Memento's armour regen on kills covers the survivability gaps between reloads. Stack Hazard Protection until the bleed is negated, get Memento stacks flowing early in each encounter, then stay aggressive. A genuinely fun build once it clicks; a frustrating one until it does.
